title: Readable BAZAAR name board over the portal
where: north face, above the portal x7..9, y4..6, z2 (wall z3)
instruction: The current board has tiny text. Use plaque(g, "BAZAAR", {at:[9,5,3], face:"north", width:3, height:2}) with a banner or block-letter style, or signboard with B.sign("dark_oak", ["BAZAAR"], {glow:true, color:"orange"}); letters must contrast with a lighter board (spruce or birch planks).

title: Real arch head on the portal
where: north face, portal x7..9, y1..4, z3..4
instruction: The arch carve is hidden under the dark lintel. Add an arch-shaped head with `surround arch` (mcd paint rule: `north rows 1-4 cols 7-9 openings -> surround arch dark_oak round`) or arch(g,{carve:false, frame:"stripped_dark_oak_log"}) so a round dark-oak ring reads at street distance.

title: Orange ring on the dome
instruction: Replace the sandstone-stair ring at y8 with red_sandstone_stairs keeping each stair's facing/half/shape (read the state with g.blockAt / mcd faces roof), so the dome gets the concept's orange band above the orange drum ring.

title: Wind tower slits and cap
instruction: Make the slits 1 wide x 2 tall on the north/south faces only (remove the iron bars on the east/west faces), put dark_oak_trapdoor shutters (open) beside them, and replace the slab cap with a cut_sandstone stair ring (B.stairs facing outward, half top) so the top reads as a lip.

title: Awning valance and pennants
where: north face, awning front edges z1, y2, x2..6 and x10..14
instruction: Hang a dark_oak_trapdoor (open, facing north, half top) under the front row of each awning at y2 between the posts, and add two B.banner("orange", [["stripe_bottom","white"],["border","brown"]], {facing:"north"}) pennants on the buttress fronts at (1,3,1) and (15,3,1) (already one each: add a second row at y2 with a different pattern: ["triangle_top","white"]).

title: More clay pots and baskets on the platform
instruction: Place 4-6 decorated_pot / composter (levels 2-6) / hay_block props at (1,1,1), (15,1,1), (4,1,2), (12,1,2), (8,1,1) keeping x4 and x12 clear for walking; pots go on the floor, never in the door line x7..9.

title: Lanterns on the awning posts
instruction: Use fixture(g,{at:[x,3,1], face:"north", mount:"bracket", lamp:"lantern", arm:"dark_oak_fence", bracket:"dark_oak_planks"}) on the portal-side posts (6 and 10), or hang lanterns from a dark_oak_slab beam between post and wall at y3, so each bay has one light.

title: Terrace shrubs in planters
instruction: Add 2 planter beds with planter(g,{at:[12,7,10], face:"north", width:3, kind:"ground", plants:["azalea","flowering_azalea"]}) so the terrace carries the concept's green shrubs; never loose leaves.

title: Hall interior: stall tables and rugs
instruction: Add two rows of barrels / chests / hay_block stall tables at z6 and z9 on x3..5 and x11..13, a lantern per table (hanging from the y5 ceiling at y4), and extend the orange/white carpet runway with red_carpet borders on x6 and x10.

title: Vary the wall courses
where: all four exterior faces, y4..6 (frieze) and y1 (base)
instruction: Texture the frieze: replace every 5th sandstone block at y4 with cut_sandstone in a staggered pattern (not touching), and replace the y1 base course with smooth_sandstone only on the piers. Do NOT use `weather` or `vary` rules: on this palette they produce stray granite/gravel-grey blocks.

title: Back wall frieze detail
instruction: The back above the band is a blank 13x3 field. Add `cornice stepped sandstone` on the top row and 3 narrow clerestory slits (iron_bars 1x2 at y4..5, x4, x8, x12) behind dark_oak_trapdoor shutters.
